title: 第3章 君无意
content_zh:
“罢了，虽在一家，但你却是为了躲避我，刻意住到了府邸最南边，唉……明日你就搬回这里来吧！”再深深看了君邪一眼，君战天痛惜的道。再怎么纨绔再怎么不争气，也总还是自己的孙子，而且，也是君家唯一的血脉……

眼下，虽然外事靖平，但几位皇子都已经慢慢长大成人，正是内潮汹涌的时候，自己身为军方第一人，就好像一棵参天大树，每个人都想靠过来或者等着自己靠过去，而对自己唯一的血脉下手，正是栽赃嫁祸的绝顶好计！若是君邪不搬回来，恐怕以后这样的事情还会层出不穷。

“我住在那里，挺好的，不用搬了吧！”君邪一口拒绝，开玩笑，正要见识见识这个世界的杀手同行是什么样子，若是搬回来岂不就丧失了这个机会？在君老爷子说起这件事情的时候，君邪心中就有些隐隐的兴奋。

杀手……那已经是很遥远的事情了，可那却也最亲切的记忆……

“你！……混账！”君老爷子为之气结，扬起了大巴掌就要抽下来，掌到临头却又顿住，长声一叹，目光复杂，“你……去吧。”

这是这小子第一次拒绝自己吗？！他……今日居然敢拒绝我？！而且还拒绝的如此干脆？

君邪躬身一礼，随即站直身子，转身就走。

“哦，还有一件事，以后你不得再去缠着灵梦公主，这桩事情，没有商量的余地，就此作罢！”君老爷子的声音之中，有着难以言喻的颓意，还有隐隐的心灰意冷！

这几年来，君家虽然看似权势熏天，几乎就是当朝一人，但却始终有一个致命的缺点，就是后继乏人！第三代唯一的后人也只得君莫邪这个纨绔小子而已！君老爷子看似四旬之人，心态何尝不老，洞悉世情，情知万一有一日自己撒手人间，君家只怕会在很短的时间之内被人彻底从这世上抹去。以目前君莫邪的情况看，这种可能性几乎已经是必然结局，甚至这根本就是可以看到的最终结局。

所以君战天曾经腆着老脸，向皇帝提出希望君莫邪能够迎娶皇帝陛下最为宠爱的灵梦公主为妻，若是此事能成，就算自己西去，那么君邪有自己的余威庇佑，又占着一个公主夫婿、皇亲国戚的名头，只要不太出格，再怎么混想来也能保全君家香火不致断绝。

公主夫婿，看似风光，其实却是朝野上下一个最尴尬的职位，只要是甚有权势的大臣家庭，人人都害怕皇帝突然赐婚，让自己儿子娶个公主回家来：公公婆婆却要对儿媳妇行跪拜之礼？尤其是除了公主特许，驸马是绝对禁止纳妾的，万一公主是位性格乖张、妒心重点，那一家子想过好还真的很困难。可是，对如君莫邪这样的纨绔小子却是一个极大的保证，至少为君家香火计，已经是一个最好的方案！

所以君战天提出这桩婚事，也真是迫于无奈之举。

皇帝陛下自然了解自己这位老战友也是老大哥的心意，闻言之下也有意动，但在仔细了解了一番君莫邪的所作所为之后，再加上灵梦公主抵死不从，思虑良久，终于还是拒绝了。

“君大哥，非是小弟不愿意卖大哥脸面，可小弟也是为人父啊，灵梦又是小弟最心爱的女儿，如何能够将自己的女儿委身于……唉！”皇帝陛下放低了姿态未说完的这句话，让君战天一口气几乎上不来。

身为人父？为女儿考虑？若是在十年前，我君家最鼎盛的时期，就算莫邪再纨绔十倍，只要老夫提出婚事，你还不是大喜欲狂？人情冷暖，如人饮水！这是君老爷子心中的怨念。

“哦，我知道了。”君邪在门口站住，淡淡的道。语气之中，无惊无喜，平淡的像是一碗白开水，随即便一步迈了出去。

自从君老爷子表露出这层意思之后，君莫邪便一直以灵梦公主的夫婿的身份自居，对灵梦公主一味的死缠烂打，让她烦不胜烦。但君老爷子此刻见到自己孙子这副不咸不淡的样子，却颇有些惊讶、意外。君邪或是怒发冲冠，或是竭斯底里，甚至是泼妇骂街……老爷子都不会诧异，唯独他这样的淡然，却是让君战天大出意料之外。

“摔了一下，怎么却变了性子？”君老爷子捻着胡子，看着出门去的君邪的背影，目光深邃。

良久，君战天一拍手，道：“多派几位好手，日夜护卫在少爷身边，不得再有任何闪失！若是再有不开眼之人，就地格杀！无须有任何顾忌！”这种事情，可一而不可再，我君战天的孙儿，怎能容你们加害？君老爷子双目中闪过一道寒光。

空荡荡的大厅，君老爷子似乎在和空气说话，但，却随即不知从什么地方传出来一个飘飘渺渺的声音：“是！”

君邪迎着朝阳走了出来，温和的阳光招在他略显苍白的面孔上，漫步向着自己居住的小院子行去，一路上不断有下人诚惶诚恐的行礼，君邪一概不理，径自在想着自己的心事。

没有人知道，在这位君三公子的心中，此刻正回荡着一段段话语：

“什么是杀手？顾名思义，杀手，就是杀人的手！杀人的黑手！一定要记住，这个‘黑’字！…”

“杀手，从来都是虚幻的，来自于飘渺，消失于虚无！”

“怎样才算是一个成功的杀手？如果一个杀手直到他自己死亡的那一天，依然无人知道他是一个双手沾满血腥的杀手，那他就是一个成功的杀手！”

“那么，怎样才算是一个合格的超级杀手？”

“所谓合格的杀手，能够在任何的情况下隐藏自己！跟文人在一起，他就是一个墨客；跟画家在一起，他就是艺术家；跟**在一起，他就是一个恶棍；跟贵妇在一起，他就是一个贵族，一位绅士；跟涩狼在一起，他就是淫棍！跟英雄在一起，他就是楷模！”

“在沙漠之中，他就是蜥蜴；到了大草原上，他就是狼王！回归山岭之中，他是百兽之王猛虎！浮游大海之上，他就是兴风作浪的神龙！”

“如此，才是一个合格的、成功的杀手！”

“一味只知道杀人，充其量不过是一个屠夫罢了！”

“只为求目的而杀人，即使每次都会成功，顶多只能算是一个优秀刺客！”

“杀人！本身也是一种艺术！身为一个杀手，就永远不能、不要亵du了这份艺术的高雅！”

这是前世的时候，君邪和师傅的一段对话，想着想着，君邪嘴角露出一丝笑容，喃喃的道：“……补充一点，生在现在这种家庭，我就是一个混吃等死的二世祖！”

突然一个声音冷峭的道：“错！你不是二世祖！我才是二世祖，而你，是三世祖！”

content_en:
"Well, even though we are in the same family, you deliberately moved to the southernmost part of the mansion to avoid me. Alas... you can move back here tomorrow!" Jun Xie took another deep look at Jun Xie and said with regret.No matter how dandy he is, no matter how disappointing he is, he is still his grandson, and he is also the only bloodline of the Jun family...

At present, although the external affairs are peaceful, several princes have slowly grown up. It is when the internal tide is raging. As the leader of the military, he is like a towering tree. Everyone wants to get closer or is waiting for him to get closer. And attacking his only bloodline is a perfect way to frame the situation!If Jun Xie doesn't move back, I'm afraid things like this will continue to happen in the future.

"I live there, it's fine. There's no need to move!" Jun Xie refused and joked. He was about to see what fellow killers in this world are like. If he moved back, wouldn't he lose this opportunity?When Mr. Jun talked about this matter, Jun Xie felt a little excited in his heart.

The killer...that is already a very distant thing, but it is also the most intimate memory...

"You!... Bastard!" Mr. Jun was furious. He raised his big slap and was about to pull it off. However, he paused when the slap was about to hit him. He let out a long sigh and said with complicated eyes, "You... go ahead."

Is this the first time this kid has rejected him?!He... dared to reject me today?!And he refused so simply?

Jun Xie bowed, then stood up straight, turned around and left.

"Oh, one more thing, you are not allowed to pester Princess Lingmeng in the future. There is no room for negotiation on this matter, let's just let it go!" There was indescribable dejection in Mr. Jun's voice, as well as a hint of dismay!

In the past few years, although the Jun family seems to be extremely powerful and almost the only one in the dynasty, it has always had a fatal flaw, that is, there is a lack of successors!The only descendant of the third generation is Jun Moxie, a playboy!Mr. Jun looks like a man in his forties, but his mentality is not old. He has a thorough understanding of the world and knows that if he passes away one day, the Jun family will be completely wiped out from this world in a short period of time.Judging from Jun Moxie's current situation, this possibility is almost an inevitable outcome, and this is even the final outcome that can be seen.

Therefore, Jun Zhantian once shyly expressed the hope to the emperor that Jun Moxie could marry His Majesty the Emperor's favorite Princess Lingmeng. If this could happen, even if he went west, Jun Xie would have the protection of his own remaining power, and he would also occupy the title of a princess's husband and a relative of the emperor. As long as he didn't go out of his way, no matter how much he thought about it, he could keep the Jun family's fragrance from being cut off.

Princess husband-in-law may seem like a prestigious position, but in fact it is the most embarrassing position in the government and the public. As long as it is a powerful minister's family, everyone is afraid that the emperor will suddenly grant a marriage to his son and let his son marry a princess. But the father-in-law and the mother-in-law have to kneel down and worship the daughter-in-law?In particular, except for the princess's charter, the prince-in-law is absolutely prohibited from taking concubines. If the princess has a perverse personality and is very jealous, it will be really difficult for the family to think well.However, for a dandy like Jun Moxie, it is a great guarantee. At least for the sake of the Jun family, it is already the best plan!

Therefore, Jun Zhantian proposed this marriage out of necessity.

His Majesty the Emperor naturally understood the feelings of his old comrade-in-arms and big brother, and he was also interested in moving after hearing the words. However, after carefully understanding what Jun Moxie had done, and the fact that Princess Lingmeng refused to obey, after thinking for a long time, he finally refused.

"Brother Jun, it's not that I don't want to sell my brother's face, but I am also a father, and Lingmeng is my most beloved daughter. How can I devote my daughter to... Oh!" His Majesty the Emperor lowered his attitude and finished the sentence, which made Jun Zhantian almost unable to breathe.

Being a father?Think about your daughter?If ten years ago, when my Jun family was at its peak, even if Mo Xie was ten times more dandy, wouldn't you be overjoyed as soon as I proposed marriage?Human feelings are warm and cold, just like people drinking water!This is the resentment in Mr. Jun's heart.

"Oh, I understand." Jun Xie stopped at the door and said calmly.There was no surprise or joy in his tone, as calm as a bowl of boiled water, and he took a step forward.

Ever since Mr. Jun revealed this meaning, Jun Moxie has been claiming to be Princess Lingmeng's husband and has been stalking Princess Lingmeng, annoying her.But when Mr. Jun saw his grandson's neither salty nor cool look, he was quite surprised and surprised.Jun Xie was either furious, hysterical, or even a shrew... The old man would not be surprised, but his indifference surprised Jun Zhantian.

"You fell down, but why did you change your temper?" Mr. Jun twirled his beard and looked at Jun Xie's back as he went out, his eyes deep.

After a long time, Jun Zhantian clapped his hands and said: "Send a few more good soldiers to guard the young master day and night. Don't make any mistakes again! If there are any more unscrupulous people, kill them on the spot! No need to have any scruples!" This kind of thing can never happen again. How can I, Jun Zhantian's grandson, allow you to harm me?A cold light flashed in Mr. Jun's eyes.

In the empty hall, Mr. Jun seemed to be talking to the air, but then a vague voice came from somewhere: "Yes!"

Jun Xie walked out to face the morning sun. The gentle sunlight shone on his slightly pale face. He strolled towards the small courtyard where he lived. Along the way, servants kept paying sincere salutes. Jun Xie ignored them and kept thinking about his own thoughts.

No one knows that in the heart of the Third Young Master Jun, passages of words are echoing at this moment:

"What is a killer? As the name suggests, a killer is the hand that kills! The black hand that kills! You must remember the word 'black'!..."

"Killers are always illusory, coming from the mist and disappearing into nothingness!"

"What is a successful killer? If no one knows that a killer is a killer with bloody hands until the day he dies, then he is a successful killer!"

"So, what makes a qualified super killer?"

"The so-called qualified killer can hide himself under any circumstances! With literati, he is a poet; with painters, he is an artist; with prostitutes, he is a villain; with ladies, he is a nobleman, a gentleman; with a wolf, he is a whore! With heroes, he is a role model!"

"In the desert, he is a lizard; in the prairie, he is the wolf king! Back in the mountains, he is the tiger, the king of beasts! Floating in the sea, he is the dragon making waves!"

"This is how you become a qualified and successful killer!"

"If you only know how to kill people, you are nothing more than a butcher!"

"Killing just for the purpose, even if you succeed every time, you can only be regarded as an excellent assassin at best!"

"Killing! It is also an art in itself! As a killer, you can never, never desecrate the elegance of this art!"

This was a conversation between Jun Xie and his master in his previous life. After thinking about it, a smile appeared on Jun Xie's lips and he murmured: "...To add to this, if I was born into a family like this, I would be a second-generation ancestor who just eats and waits for death!"

Suddenly a cold voice said: "Wrong! You are not the second generation ancestor! I am the second generation ancestor, and you are the third generation ancestor!"
